title: Design System: Sabino Software Field Dossier

display.purpose: The homepage promise only; decisive, compressed, and deliberately line-broken.

headline.purpose: Major evidence sections and the founder or contact close.

title.purpose: Dossier findings and other proof-bearing statements.

body.purpose: Readable explanations, case evidence, and supporting product copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, dossier indices, controls, technology tags, dates, and telemetry.

shadows.name: ambient-raised
shadows.purpose: Mobile navigation and isolated raised panels.

shadows.name: operating-brief
shadows.purpose: Separates the operating brief from the hero topology.

shadows.name: contact-glass
shadows.purpose: Anchors the protected form within the contact field.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Tiny live signals and the scroll trace only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Button, tab, border, and color response.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Navigation, cards, and simple surface response.

motion.name: content-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time viewport fade, blur, and rise.

motion.name: language-recompile
motion.purpose: Decorative bilingual interface swap; removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-priority conversation or submission action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 17px; border: 1px solid var(--signal); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--signal); font: 700 0.78rem/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary::after { content: '↗'; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #e4ff78; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:hover::after { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-priority route to supporting proof or an external artifact.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 17px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--paper); background: rgba(13, 17, 16, 0.72); font: 700 0.78rem/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary::after { content: '↗'; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(216, 255, 79, 0.6); background: var(--panel-raised); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-secondary:hover::after { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Compact Navigation
components.description: Monospaced proof routes with one lime conversation action.
components.html: worksystems labBRstart a conversation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(8, 11, 10, 0.88); font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted-strong); font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--paper); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-language { border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--cyan); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { border: 1px solid rgba(216, 255, 79, 0.42); color: var(--ink); background: var(--signal); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dossier Tab
components.description: An inactive evidence slot in the horizontally scrollable dossier rail.
components.css: .ds-dossier-tab { position: relative; display: grid; min-width: 156px; min-height: 58px; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 15px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); background: rgba(7, 11, 9, 0.76); font: 650 0.72rem/1.2 var(--font-mono); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-dossier-tab span { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 0.58rem; } .ds-dossier-tab:hover { color: var(--paper); background: rgba(216, 255, 79, 0.05); } .ds-dossier-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Selected Dossier Tab
components.description: The one selected dossier, marked by contrast and a lime trace.
components.css: .ds-dossier-tab-selected { position: relative; display: grid; min-width: 156px; min-height: 58px; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 15px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--paper); background: rgba(216, 255, 79, 0.05); font: 650 0.72rem/1.2 var(--font-mono); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dossier-tab-selected span { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 0.58rem; } .ds-dossier-tab-selected::after { position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; left: 14px; height: 2px; background: var(--signal); content: ''; } .ds-dossier-tab-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Production Dossier Panel
components.description: The one-open-file split between identity and concrete engineering evidence.
components.html:
CASE_001 / DATA PLATFORM

Transfeera

Principal Data Software Engineer

From a fragile pipeline to a declarative platform.

Concrete engineering evidence belongs here, followed by bounded findings and technology tags.
components.css: .ds-dossier-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.36fr 0.64fr; min-height: 360px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0 0 30px 30px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--panel); } .ds-dossier-identity { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 36px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); background: radial-gradient(circle at 22% 76%, rgba(216, 255, 79, 0.1), transparent 48%), var(--ink-soft); } .ds-dossier-identity small { color: var(--cyan); font: 650 0.7rem/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-dossier-identity h3 { margin: auto 0 12px; font: 620 3rem/0.95 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: -0.06em; } .ds-dossier-identity p, .ds-dossier-detail p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); } .ds-dossier-detail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 46px; } .ds-dossier-detail h4 { margin: 0 0 24px; font: 580 2.4rem/1.07 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: -0.05em; } .ds-dossier-panel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Tag
components.description: A compact technology, maturity, or clearance label.
components.css: .ds-evidence-tag { display: inline-flex; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--muted-strong); background: transparent; font: 400 0.58rem/1 var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: A square dark field with unmistakable cyan focus and coral invalid state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.63rem/1.4 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.035em; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 47px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; outline: none; color: var(--paper); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025); caret-color: var(--signal); font: 0.88rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--cyan); background: rgba(93, 228, 231, 0.035); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(93, 228, 231, 0.08); } .ds-field input:user-invalid { border-color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 0.7); }

components.css: .ds-operating-brief { width: min(100%, 390px); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(93, 228, 231, 0.34); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--muted-strong); background: rgba(6, 10, 8, 0.91); box-shadow: 12px 18px 52px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38); font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-operating-brief header { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-operating-brief header strong { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.075em; } .ds-operating-brief header span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-operating-brief header i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(216, 255, 79, 0.72); } .ds-operating-brief ul { margin: 0; padding: 11px 18px 13px; list-style: none; } .ds-operating-brief li { display: grid; min-height: 44px; grid-template-columns: 88px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(231, 241, 235, 0.08); } .ds-operating-brief li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-operating-brief b { color: var(--paper); font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-operating-brief li span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-operating-brief footer { padding: 14px 18px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); } .ds-operating-brief code { color: var(--signal); font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Contact Recovery
components.description: Colocated recovery actions shown when secure contact cannot initialize or submit.
components.html: continue on LinkedIn ↗
components.css: .ds-contact-recovery { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 20px; align-items: center; font: 650 0.68rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); } .ds-contact-recovery button, .ds-contact-recovery a { min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; color: var(--cyan); background: transparent; font: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-contact-recovery button:hover, .ds-contact-recovery a:hover { color: var(--signal); } .ds-contact-recovery button:focus-visible, .ds-contact-recovery a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Sabino Software presents itself as a calm technical due-diligence file, not an agency brochure or generic SaaS dashboard. The interface lets a visitor understand the offer, inspect selected production evidence, see the operating method, and begin a high-context conversation. It is dense enough to reward technical scrutiny but disciplined enough to keep one unmistakable reading path.

The material world is a near-black matte systems field: precise hairline rules, faint engineering grids, restrained topology art, and i3-like terminal details. Off-white carries the argument. Acid lime marks action and selection; cyan marks telemetry, navigation, and focus. Glow is scarce and functional. The result should feel like an accountable engineer's working dossier rather than speculative futurism.

Lowercase editorial presentation is part of the identity, but it never overrides factual casing. Sabino Software, Sabino Software Ltda, Felipe Sabino, company names, AI, AWS, GCP, Azure, EC2, EKS, APIs, CDC, SQL, and other proper technical terms retain their official forms in both languages.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence precedes service claims, and progressive disclosure keeps one technical file in focus.
Near-black matte surfaces, exact rules, low-contrast grids, and controlled signal glow create depth without visual noise.
Variable Archivo carries compressed, decisive display type; a system-monospace stack carries labels, controls, state, and telemetry.
Lime means action or selected proof; cyan means system state, navigation, or focus.
English and Brazilian Portuguese share one information architecture, interaction model, and level of care.
Real artifacts, explicit maturity labels, confidentiality boundaries, and recorded provenance carry every claim.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime answers “what can I do or what is selected?” Cyan answers “where am I, what has focus, or what is the system reporting?” Do not swap their roles.

rules.name: The Dark-Field Rule
rules.body: Increase hierarchy with paper, muted copy, rules, and tonal layering before adding a brighter surface.

rules.name: The Functional-Color Rule
rules.body: Amber and coral appear only when the content carries warning, restriction, invalidity, or failure semantics.

rules.name: The Compressed-Not-Tiny Rule
rules.body: Create density with font stretch, weight, line height, and concise copy; never shrink essential labels into illegibility.

rules.name: The Casing-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Lowercase the editorial interface where established, but preserve every official name, acronym, technology, and language-specific proper noun exactly.

rules.name: The One-Display-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo owns both display and body continuity. Monospace supports the dossier grammar; it does not replace prose.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Production proof remains ahead of the capability menu. Do not turn the homepage back into a services-first brochure.

rules.name: The One-Open-File Rule
rules.body: A dossier rail may contain seven choices, but only one detailed dossier panel is visible at a time on every viewport.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Static content surfaces use borders and tone. Shadows belong to overlays, the operating brief, or the protected contact layer.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Glow must indicate activity, focus, or verified signal. Never wash whole sections in neon.

rules.name: The Enclosure-Has-a-Job Rule
rules.body: Curves identify a bounded object; square edges identify a rail, field, trace, or working surface.

rules.name: The No-Soft-Card-Grid Rule
rules.body: Do not apply large rounded rectangles indiscriminately. Repeated evidence becomes a ledger, rail, or one-open file before it becomes a grid of cards.

dos: **Do** preserve the proof-first homepage sequence and the seven exact dossier slots.
**Do** keep exactly one dossier tab selected and one matching panel visible, with aligned tab IDs, `aria-controls`, panel IDs, and `aria-labelledby` values.
**Do** use lime for action/selection and cyan for telemetry/navigation/focus.
**Do** preserve skip links, semantic landmarks, heading order, visible focus, polite live status, 44px effective controls, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep English and Brazilian Portuguese structurally equivalent, with accurate `lang`, `hreflang`, metadata, control labels, and official casing.
**Do** update readable `assets/css/site.css` / `assets/js/site.js` and their checked-in minified counterparts together; the HTML loads the minified files.
**Do** preserve every asset's provenance record and the career-history no-endorsement statement.
**Do** keep public evidence, confidentiality labels, project maturity, and recovery copy factual and current.
**Do** verify responsive changes at the established 1080px, 1050px, 850px, and 620px transitions, with extra attention around the 1051/1050 navigation boundary.
donts: **Don't** literalize fabricated status metrics, unsupported recency, tiny telemetry labels, or invented case copy from the direction comp.
**Don't** add testimonials, endorsements, benchmarks, client identities, certifications, pricing, revenue, or outcomes without approved evidence.
**Don't** turn the dossier into a generic dashboard, a bento archive, a full portfolio dump, or a services-first agency page.
**Don't** lowercase company names, personal names, acronyms, or technologies for aesthetic consistency.
**Don't** use glow as decoration, add purple cyberpunk saturation, introduce stock imagery, or place pseudo-text inside generated art.
**Don't** animate information that cannot be reached in reduced-motion mode or understood from semantic HTML.
**Don't** log or transmit contact-field contents through analytics, expose authentication state, or remove the Retry and LinkedIn recovery route.
**Don't** imply that career-history logos are Sabino Software clients or endorsers.
